transcription.notes: One reading from the image, not independently re-checked; the receiver's stroke through the third digit of each group makes some digits doubtful (marked ?). 54 items + 18 clear words = 72 = the form's word count. Against the first pass (15 groups of m0021 only): adds 4965? and 89864? at the start, reads 39644 (not 37644), and adds the 37 items of sheet 2 (m0022).

system.summary: Telegraphic code of five-digit groups over 00000-99999 with short items 05 and 06, between clear Portuguese openings and closings; not Sabugosa's alphabetical code.
system.sibling_key: Sabugosa's alphabetical code (targets/sabugosa1910): tested, no group matches, also with the struck third digit dropped.
system.notes: distinct_symbols = distinct items over the three telegrams (groups.py). The two long telegrams share 37708, 39644, 93608 and 97183, and open with a parallel run after the same clear words 'Tudo bem tempo lindo': 37708 ... 97183 39644 05/06. The receiver at Pena struck each group through its third digit (m0021-22) or dashed it (m0015); the meaning is unknown.

prior_solution.where: No decode in M13; no printed decipherment found (one web search by the first pass). M13 m0001-m0002 hold a pencil text in telegram style signed Manuel (London, a dinner given by the Queen Mother), which may be the decode of a telegram not in the file; it does not match these three.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT chose the catalogue items and set the rules; AI language-model agents fetched the images and transcribed them. No hand correction recorded.
tools: groups.py (counts, repeats, shared groups, chance control)
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT); a vision-capable language model for the transcription

solution.what: All 22 images of M13 fetched through the DigitArq JSON backend. Telegram forms on m0015, m0017, m0019, m0021, m0022 (three telegrams: m0015+m0017, m0019, m0021+m0022).
Transcribed the three telegrams with headers and stamps: 36, 3 and 54 items; the word counts on the forms (54, 72) match.

Repeats and shared groups: m0015 and m0021 share 37708, 39644, 93608, 97183 and open with a parallel run; m0019 repeats three groups of m0022. Random telegrams of the same sizes share two groups in about 1 of 10,000 trials.

Tried Sabugosa's 52 code values (targets/sabugosa1910) on the 79 five-digit groups, as written and with the struck third digit dropped: no match, and 7 groups would fall above the last known value (veio 9019). Not the same code in that form.
Looked through the clear letters of M13 for a decode: none for these telegrams.

outcome.method_basis: No decode of the time and no codebook; the groups are transcribed and the repeats listed.
